text:
Maya K.: heads up — noticing a spike in handoff latency this morning, ~6-8% of inbound leads are sitting in enrichment >15m. HubSpot shows 'enrichment-pending' state.
Devon: ugh, saw that too. looks correlated with a retry loop on our enrichment webhook.
Aj Tran: is this the RR router or HS workflow?
Maya K.: initial triage -> enrichment service returning 502 on some payload shapes, HS retries, then our round-robin claim attempt times out and the lead goes back to queue.
Lee (ops): can we add a lightweight heartbeat/pingback probe from HS so we don't try claim until enrichment ack? short-term workaround.
Devon: +1. simplest: add a custom property `enrichment_ready` set by our service when processing completes. HS workflow will only assign when true. avoids claim thrash.
Maya K.: that helps but we still need faster recovery if enrichment fails permanently. propose: claim-retry with exponential backoff and a global TTL for unclaimed leads (default-owner fallback after 20m).
Aj Tran: agree. draft playbook: 1) heartbeat probe endpoint `/lead_ping` that returns 200/202 with JSON {status: "received"}; 2) HS only triggers RR assign on `enrichment_ready==true` or `enrichment_attempts>=3`; 3) After TTL (20m) set `owner=marketing_inbound_default`.
Lee (ops): canary this in prod for 1h on 10% of leads and monitor claim latency + duplicate assignments. if anything weird, rollback HS workflow.
Maya K.: can we add a short log snippet to help oncalls? e.g.:
```
[2026-03-21T09:12:34Z] lead=LP-12345 enrichment=timeout attempts=2 rr_claim=timed_out
[2026-03-21T09:12:35Z] lead=LP-12345 set_property enrichment_attempts=3
[2026-03-21T09:12:36Z] lead=LP-12345 enrichment_ready=false -> defer assign
```
Devon: pingback curl example for ops to test: `curl -X POST https://internal-api/redwood/enrichment/ping -d '{"lead": "LP-12345"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $AUTH'` returns `{"status":"accepted"}`. add to runbook.
rebecca-automation-bot: Incident rule created: slack #marketing alert if unclaimed>5% for 10m. (rule id: RB-5567)
Aj Tran: small UX ask — update HubSpot owner-card tooltip to explain default fallback owner behavior so SDRs don't get confused when they see temporary default owners.
Lee (ops): I'll push the HS workflow change to canary at 10:20 PST, monitoring window 60m. tagging @Devon and @Aj for rollout.
Maya K.: thanks — please add a short postmortem if the canary finds non-trivial flakes. Otherwise we'll codify heartbeat + TTL into the inbound playbook. :thumbsup:
Devon: will add a short PR with the workflow XML and the ping endpoint stub. cc: @Lee for ops config.
Aj Tran: leaving this thread for visibility. if anyone needs to escalate, paging oncall. :rotating_light:
Maya K.: pfyi we'll also add a metric `enrichment_ack_latency_p95` to the marketing dashboard so product + ops can track regressions.
Lee (ops): done — probe deployed to staging. scheduling canary for 10:20.
Devon: PR link: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/marketing-workflows/pull/212 (draft)
Maya K.: perfect — thanks all.
